name: Tide Titan
primary:
A giant tide titan rises waist-deep from the ground at the aimed spot and fights from there while you keep the channel.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel and the titan sinks back underground; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky above the aimed spot.
It picks foes within 20 blocks and, about every 1.5 s, either throws water orbs that burst within 2.5 blocks: damage 4 ❤ water, wet for 8 s, knockback;
or slams the ground with both fists, which raises a geyser and leaves a puddle for 6 s; everyone within 5 blocks takes 3 ❤ water, gets wet and is thrown back.
self_description:
On you:
• Wet for 10 s
• Regeneration, 5 s
